subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be treated primarily as a shared-main-session configuration problem, a Telegram/session routing defect, a stop/cancel delivery defect, or a new semantic runaway-output guardrail?
rationale: The available diagnostics prove a real incident window but omit raw content and peer identities, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary or owner path.

options.title: Route as session isolation first
options.body: Treat default main-session DM sharing as the likely cause and decide whether docs, onboarding, doctor guidance, or a default change is appropriate for multi-user Telegram deployments.

options.title: Route as Telegram/runtime bug
options.body: Ask the Telegram and runtime owners to correlate the diagnostics against direct-chat target selection, stop/cancel handling, and reply dispatch before choosing a code fix.

options.title: Keep as information-only until reproduced
options.body: Require a current-main reproduction with redacted transcripts or richer diagnostics before assigning a code owner or changing behavior.

recommendation.title: Route as session isolation first
recommendation.body: Treat default main-session DM sharing as the likely cause and decide whether docs, onboarding, doctor guidance, or a default change is appropriate for multi-user Telegram deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: The first decision hinges on session-scope semantics and current default DM routing, where this history is most directly relevant.
